ui_location: Proximal Tibia > Schatzker Classification > Type III Pure Depression

ui_location: Proximal Tibia > Schatzker Classification > Type IV Medial Plateau

quote: In type V fractures, as the name suggests, both the medial and lateral tibial plateaus are broken but the metaphysis and diaphysis maintain continuity.

web_text_verbatim: Lauge-Hansen Classification: Based on foot position and deforming force direction (SER, SA, PER, PA), describing sequential progression of ligamentous and osseous injury
suggested_fix: None needed. Confirmed in Rockwood 10th ed.

The number then refers to the progression through stages of bony and soft tissue injury. The most common pattern of injury is SER (60%) followed by SAD injuries (20%) and then those occurring in pronation (20%).
